output.content: I spent the morning tracing the risk assessment workflow with the operations team. A planner opens a shared spreadsheet and types the risk score for each article by hand. They then copy those scores into the deployment checklist. I timed the process for the last three promotion weeks. It takes roughly four hours per week. The spreadsheet is the only record of the assessment. No logs are generated when a score is changed. The data moves from the spreadsheet to the deployment system via a manual copy and paste action.
